FEAT-4-STORY-46.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema Contract
FEAT-4-STORY-46.description: Create a Pydantic model defining the standardized provider detail response including demographics, credentials, practice locations, and external links to ensure consistent downstream consumption.

FEAT-4-STORY-47.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Tool Router
FEAT-4-STORY-47.description: Register provider detail lookup as an allowed tool and wire it through the tool_router with validated inputs and structured outputs for LLM invocation.

FEAT-4-STORY-48.title: Integrate Provider Detail Service into EvaluateCare Facade
FEAT-4-STORY-48.description: Connect provider_detail_service to evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate provider lookup requests and return normalized, validated responses to the chat layer.

FEAT-4-STORY-49.title: Implement Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
FEAT-4-STORY-49.description: Create test coverage for provider_detail_service including schema validation, API error handling, and end-to-end integration through the facade and tool router.
